claims.text: Defect classes a gate must kill COMPLETELY before its green means anything.

The floor for the overall kill rate. Deliberately not 1.0: a gate that kills every mutant a corpus author could think of has usually been fitted to the corpus. It is the CRITICAL classes that must be absolute.

A regeneration command that exits 0 without making the source fresh is the failure mode that would otherwise be reported as success, and this repo has been bitten by precisely that shape more than once.
